data.gender_notes: Mishkaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A repository or container of knowledge, wisdom, or blessings. The name Mishkaat carries the meaning “Chest, container, repository” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mishkaat usually hope their child will grow to embody chest, container, repository and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the heart or container of one's faith and devotion.
data.etymology: Mishkaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chest, container, repository.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mishkaat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مِشْكَاة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المِشْكَاة مصدر من مشكّ، بمعنى "نور" أو "مصباح". ويُرمز إلى النور الإلهي الذي يهدي الإنسان في ظلام الجهالة. يُستَشهد به في القرآن الكريم في سورة النور، حيث يُقال "وَإِنَّ مِشْكَاةً أَنْذِرُوا " (النور: 35). في الثقافة الإسلامية، يُعتبر اسم مِشْكَاة رمزًا للنور الحقيقي والهداية الروحية.

in_urdu.name: مِشکات
in_urdu.meaning: نور، روشنی، یا جنت کا چراغ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مِشکات عربی کے لغتِ میں "نور" یا "مصباح" سے منسوب ہے۔ یہ اسلامی تہذیب میں نورِ الہٰی کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔ جس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں سورہ نور میں آتا ہے جہاں کہا گیا ہے "وَإِنَّ مِشْکَاةً أَنْذِرُوا" (النور: 35). اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت اس بات کی یاد دिलाتی ہے کہ ایمان والوں کی زندگی میں ہر وقت روشنی ہو۔

in_hindi.name: मिशकात
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिशकात एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'निर' या 'दीप' होता है। यह इस्लाम में आध्यात्मिक प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन का प्रतीक है। कुरान में इसका उल्लेख सूरह नूर में मिलता है जहाँ कहा गया है "وَإِنَّ مِشْکَاةً أَنْذِرُوا" (النور: 35)। इस नाम से आध्यात्मिक चेतना और ज्ञान का प्रतीक जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مِشکاټ
in_pashto.meaning: نور، نوره، يا نور د بهشت
in_pashto.long_meaning: مِشکاټ په عربی ژبه کې له مشکّ سره اړوند دی چې د "نور" یا "مصباح" معنی یې لري. د اسلامي تمدن کې مِشکاټ نور الہي ته اشاره کوي چې یو هدايتکار دی. په کورن په کتاب کې د سوره نور په ٣٥ ں آیه کې د "وَإِنَّ مِشْکَاةً أَنْذِرُوا" په ډول لیکل شوی دی. دغه نوم په پشتو تمدن کې نور او هدايت په توګه سترېږي.

in_english.name: Mishkaat
in_english.long_meaning: Mishkaat is an Arabic name meaning "light" or "lamp". It symbolizes divine light, guidance, and spiritual illumination in Islam. It's mentioned in the Quran (Surah Nur, verse 35), signifying a beacon of hope and wisdom. The name is often associated with qualities like knowledge, clarity, and inner radiance. It holds cultural significance in Muslim communities worldwide, representing the pursuit of truth and spiritual enlightenment.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mishkaat" carries a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is a term derived from the Arabic language, translating to a 'repository,' 'container,' or ' repository of knowledge.' Historically, the term "Mishkaat" was used to refer to a collection or a compiled source of Hadiths, which are sayings and acts of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). One of the most famous collections of Hadiths is "Sahih Mishkaat Al-Masabih," compiled by Muhammad Al-Khateeb Al-Shafa'i Al-Qastalani in the 13th century. This work has been a valuable source for scholars and students of Islam seeking knowledge of the Prophet's life, teachings, and practices.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Mishkaat" is rooted in its symbolism of a repository or container that houses valuable knowledge, wisdom, and blessings. In the Islamic tradition, knowledge and wisdom are seen as essential components of spiritual growth andf Islamic practices, with the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) himself emphasizing the importance of learning. The Quran states in chapter Al-Mujadilah, verse 11, "O you who believe! Fear Allah and seek knowledge."
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Mishkaat in Arabic means a fortified granary or storehouse. Symbolically, it represents the heart that stores the remembrance of Allah and the treasured knowledge of Islam. Spiritually, it signifies the protection and nurturing of the divine light within.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah The name Mishkaat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mishkaat Al-Masabih is a hadith compilation by the scholar Al-Moriqi Al-Hadadi. It was completed in 1388 AD and is considered one of the six major hadith collections in Sunni Islam.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Dhahabi's Siyar A'lam An-Nubala' The name Mishkaat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mishkaat Al-Masabih was known as Al-Masabih Al-Kabir (The Greater Masabih) during Al-Moriqi's time. It was later renamed to Mishkaat Al-Masabih by Ibn Rajab Al-Hanbali in the 14th century.
